limitations: Automated disposable native fixtures, not a manual gameplay session.
CPU wall timers and logical resource bytes; GPU execution timestamps unavailable.
64 step samples and 96 warm rotation samples per entry; p99 is a coarse tail estimate.
Initial record render does not imply every process/device cache is cold.
Confirmed punches occur before the move-ready timer; combat cost is measured separately.
interpretation: Evaluated hidden-2D native preparation. Rejected for the final implementation: no stable full-frame benefit and city rotation regressions; the full native tile draw was restored. The cause of the larger outliers is not isolated.
